notes.content:
READ ME!!!!!!@!@@@@@!!!!!!!!!! PLEEEAAASEEEE

90% of the game is hidden behind an unattainable Key!!!
consider this the only dlc for the game to be made and a huge update not an oversight

1. on start of new game once you can move press y

2. type "addKey moDream" 

3. press enter

This fixes the dream sequence you get stuck on on day 3 because steamwork api is having unintended consequences when i switch my engine to 3d mode.

ALSO THE SERVERS ARE BACK ONLINE!!!!!!!!!
visit the website to add questions into the actual games gameshow and decide whats gay together :)

https://isthisgay.gay
(comment your account name bellow and i will give u infinite post points)

The reason i cant put out an update is because i don't currently have access to the source code rn :(

(my bad guys i only ever tested on my builds with out the steam api)
